batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground Dimension Pack v0.2.0
batch_node.description: Two dimension axes as seventeen dimension nodes (req-rampart-20x-playground-dimensions): `inventory` (the axis plus seven categories) and `dataclass` (the axis, its customer and infra sub-axes, and six classes). No edges: the hierarchy is carried by the dotted name (req-dcom-naming). Each node carries `tap.meta: dimension` (core's default for the type) and NO `dcom` value: the pack is a dictionary, and dictionary entries are not entries in themselves. Node entity ids are minted once and never change; revising descriptions means a new batch id and a bumped batch name, with the node ids stable. v0.2.0 splits `inventory.os` into operating systems only and adds `inventory.containers` (req-rampart-20x-playground-inventory-dimension).

node.name: inventory
node.description: The category an inventory item belongs to. Every item on the inventory page carries one `inventory` value: `applications`, `libraries`, `os`, `containers`, `secrets`, `cloud` or `saas`. The seven values are the nodes named `inventory.<value>`. An entity carries one value or none.

node.name: inventory.applications
node.description: The `applications` category on the inventory axis: running applications inside the environment.

node.name: inventory.libraries
node.description: The `libraries` category on the inventory axis: software libraries.

node.name: inventory.os
node.description: The `os` category on the inventory axis: operating systems.

node.name: inventory.containers
node.description: The `containers` category on the inventory axis: container images, one row per class of identical image.

node.name: inventory.secrets
node.description: The `secrets` category on the inventory axis: secret material, keys, certificates and secrets.

node.name: inventory.cloud
node.description: The `cloud` category on the inventory axis: internal AWS capabilities such as Route 53, Secrets Manager, IAM and VPCs that come from the cloud but are not an application, library or OS/container.

node.name: inventory.saas
node.description: The `saas` category on the inventory axis: third-party SaaS, the interconnected cloud systems, including AWS where all of this is hosted and GitHub where the code comes from.

node.name: dataclass
node.description: The class of data an item holds or handles. Two sub-axes, `dataclass.customer` and `dataclass.infra`, each take one value per entity. Nothing is stamped with a `dataclass` value in v0; the nodes exist so classification can start without a vocabulary change.

node.name: dataclass.customer
node.description: The customer sub-axis of `dataclass`: data that belongs to customers. Its values are `dataclass.customer.data`, `dataclass.customer.creds` and `dataclass.customer.logs`.

node.name: dataclass.infra
node.description: The infrastructure sub-axis of `dataclass`: data that belongs to running the infrastructure. Its values are `dataclass.infra.code`, `dataclass.infra.secrets` and `dataclass.infra.logs`.

node.name: dataclass.customer.data
node.description: The `data` value on the `dataclass.customer` sub-axis: customer data.

node.name: dataclass.customer.creds
node.description: The `creds` value on the `dataclass.customer` sub-axis: customer credentials.

node.name: dataclass.customer.logs
node.description: The `logs` value on the `dataclass.customer` sub-axis: customer logs.

node.name: dataclass.infra.code
node.description: The `code` value on the `dataclass.infra` sub-axis: infrastructure code.

node.name: dataclass.infra.secrets
node.description: The `secrets` value on the `dataclass.infra` sub-axis: infrastructure secrets.

node.name: dataclass.infra.logs
node.description: The `logs` value on the `dataclass.infra` sub-axis: infrastructure logs.

node.name: overview
node.description: Whether an entity is drawn on the Overview page. An entity on the Overview carries the value `shown`; the Overview's Searches select on it, so the list of what the page shows is data on the entities and not a list of types in each Search. The value is the node named `overview.shown`. An entity carries one value or none.

node.name: overview.shown
node.description: The `shown` value on the overview axis: the entity is drawn on the Overview page.
